_about: Budgets for .github/scripts/perf_budget.py: first-party bytes (uncompressed) and requests at load, per template and viewport, about 15% above the heaviest of four measurements on 2026-09-24. Raise one only for a change that is meant to cost more, and say why in the commit; the script's docstring has the procedure. JS raised 25 KB on every template on 2026-10-01: the shared script grew about 40 KB with the reading, search, listing, photo and collection fixes of that week (keyboard contents, citation previews, code copy, word-start search, load-failure notes, the photo lightbox, sharper images). The homepage desktop requests went from 54 to 63 on 2026-10-13: the Latest section fills its photography panel to the height of the tallest column, which loads three to five more thumbnails (measured 55). The literature page JS went from 595 to 605 KB the same day: the shelf's spines and the reading figures gained the calendar's hover card (measured 595.5 KB). The gallery JS went from 585 to 600 KB on 2026-10-14: gallery.js shows each photograph's edits as one tile, with the edits on hover and in the lightbox (measured 590.8 KB). The homepage desktop images went from 730 to 910 KB on 2026-10-18: the Latest section fills its photography column with the newest frames, so its weight follows the newest set, and the Ann Arbor set of that day (detailed graffiti and leaves at 400px, up to 64 KB a thumbnail) measured 797 KB. The prose post JS (blog/rating-systems.html) went from 545 to 555 KB on 2026-10-19: its six charts are now HTML bar charts whose hover cards load js/diagrams.js, the script a page fetches only when it has a diagram (measured 546.2 KB). CSS went from 290 to 296 KB on every template the same day: the one stylesheet gained the diagram layouts (bar charts, flow), the Save as PNG button and stacked tables for phones (measured 290.6 KB); the scripts behind them load only on pages that use them (js/diagrams.js).
